summary: This concurrent resolution expresses congressional appreciation for local law enforcement officers by recognizing their service, thanking them and their families, honoring those killed in the line of duty, and encouraging community collaboration to improve public safety.

scores.thoughts: The resolution contains no references to budgets, appropriations, funding levels, or any form of government expenditure. It is purely a symbolic expression of support.
No provisions or language related to tax policy, rates, or revenue appear in the bill.
The bill does not address healthcare systems, coverage, or policy in any way.
While law enforcement is mentioned, the text makes no statements about firearms regulations, gun rights, or related policies.
No content concerning immigration, border policy, or related protections or restrictions.
The resolution has zero engagement with reproductive rights or abortion policy.
The bill focuses exclusively on local civilian law enforcement, not military or defense matters.
No environmental, climate, or regulatory language is present.
The text does not discuss welfare programs, entitlements, or social services.
No references to schools, education funding, or school policy.
The preamble notes that officers 'get drugs off the streets,' which implicitly endorses traditional drug enforcement efforts rather than decriminalization or legalization approaches.
The resolution praises local law enforcement for upholding the rule of law, fighting crime, and ensuring public safety, which aligns with support for conventional policing and enforcement priorities.
No trade, tariff, or globalization provisions exist.
The bill contains no fiscal policy, deficit, or debt-related content.
No language addressing LGBTQ+ protections or rights.
Foreign aid is not mentioned.
The resolution does not engage with voting access, election integrity, or electoral processes.
No provisions related to technology regulation, data privacy, or surveillance.
The bill makes no reference to labor rights, unions, or employment policy.
No content concerning religious exemptions or anti-discrimination measures.
